title: OnlyVibesStatus
description: One status message sent by a reporter every ~1s over WS /ws. The server stores the latest message per laptop and rebroadcasts all of them on WS /view.

laptop.description: Hostname of the laptop, e.g. platform.node()

owner.description: OS user that owns the laptop / runs the reporter

tailscale_ip.description: Tailscale IPv4 of the laptop (tailscale ip -4); unique key on the server

ts.description: Unix epoch seconds when the status was built

agents.description: AI coding agent processes currently running on this laptop

last_log.description: Latest non-empty line tailed from the agent's log file (raw)

summary.description: Short task title produced by server summarize() from last_log (max 6 words); may be empty on arrival or without MISTRAL_API_KEY

task.description: Optional short title of what the agent is working on, set by the reporter (e.g. Claude Code session title); may be empty
